title: Full code review follow-ups (2026-10-17)
description: Follow-up work from the full code review of develop @ e9b1923 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). The review covered the layout solver and renderer, the content boundary and Amplify backend, the Python newsroom CLI and agents, tests and CI, the newsroom UI, and docs and process. Each child issue is one PR-sized unit of work with file:line pointers and a done-when. Priority order is recorded in the epic's first comment. Done when every child issue is closed.
